about: This product will no longer be available for purchase as of 10/30/2026.
NOTE: All multiplayer servers for NBA 2K25 will be shutdown as of 12/31/2026. After that time, all game functions requiring online servers will no longer function.
This edition includes a digital copy of NBA 2K25 for PlayStation®5 and PlayStation®4.
Compete your way as you define your legacy in MyCAREER and MyTEAM, and experience MyNBA and The W on PS5® or MyLEAGUE on PS4®.
Express your personality with an array of customization options and explore an all-new City (for PS5®) or urban metropolis in the Neighborhood (for PS4®).
POWERED BY ProPLAY™ Experience your favorite NBA players’ signature moves and fine-tune your skills to deliver career-defining plays in dramatic fashion.
